blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated.
We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects “alive” through coherent interactions with the source video’s contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object.
We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE.
Each pair differs in the target object’s presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation.
We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs.
We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark.
Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively.
VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in video generation and editing have enabled high-quality results across diverse tasks, including object insertion with realistic shadows and reflections ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . However, making these objects respond coherently to source actions remains challenging. In Figure 1 , an added mug should move with the hand that lifts it, and added dough should separate as a knife cuts through it. Our goal is to make inserted objects “alive”: not merely visible in the video, but part of its world, responding to the actions unfolding around them.
blocks.zh: 录像制作和编辑方面的最新进展使各种任务都取得了高质量的成果,包括用现实的阴影和反射插入物体(Liu等,2025b;Fu等,2026)。 然而,使这些物体对源头行动作出一致反应仍然具有挑战性。 在图1中,一个被添加的杯子应该用举起它的手去移动,而被添加的面额应该作为刀切穿而来. 我们的目标是让插入的物体“活着”:不仅在录像中可见,而且在其世界的一部分,对围绕这些物体所展开的行动作出反应。

blocks.en: This capability poses two challenges: data construction and interaction modeling. Interaction editing pairs are scarce: their construction requires finding interaction videos and changing the target object’s presence while preserving the surrounding scene and action. For modeling, the source video provides action cues but does not directly show the added object’s response. The editor must infer the object’s evolving motion or state as these actions unfold.
blocks.zh: 这一能力提出了两个挑战:数据构建和互动模型。 互动编辑对很稀少:它们的构造需要找到互动视频并改变目标对象的存在,同时保留周围的场景和行动. 对于建模,源视频提供动作提示,但不直接显示所添加对象的反应. 编辑器必须推断物体的进取运动或状态,

blocks.en: ALIVE addresses these challenges, combining interaction-focused editing data with a vision-language model (VLM) that infers how added objects should respond to source actions. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. These sources cover varied interactions and visual domains, supporting general object insertion. Quality checks exclude implausible interactions and unintended changes to the surrounding scene. We annotate multi-level interaction descriptions, including temporally localized prompts, to study which guidance benefits editing and supervise VLM prediction.
blocks.zh: " 生存 " 应对这些挑战,将注重互动的编辑数据与一种视觉语言模型(VLM)结合起来,该模型可以推断新增对象应如何应对源行动。 我们整理了35,800对编辑配对, 结合了3D的,模型生成的, 和现实世界的视频 和ROSE的普通编辑配对。 这些来源涵盖了各种相互作用和视觉域,支持一般对象插入. 质量检查排除了难以想象的相互作用和对周围场景的出乎意料的改变. 我们将多层次的相互作用描述,包括时间定位的提示,用于研究哪些指导有助于编辑和监督VLM预测。

blocks.en:
Using these data, we train a first-frame-guided diffusion editor ( Ouyang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) . Users provide a source video, an edited first frame, and an object-only instruction.
The edited frame fixes the object’s initial appearance and placement, leaving subsequent behavior to follow source actions.
We train the VLM to predict temporally localized interaction prompts from the same inputs, without user-provided interaction descriptions, per-frame masks, or trajectories.
blocks.zh:
利用这些数据,我们培训了第一帧制导的传播编辑器(欧阳等,2024;刘等,2025b)。 用户提供源视频,被编辑后的第一个帧,以及只针对对象的指令.
被编辑的框架会修正对象的初始外观和位置,留下后续的行为来跟踪源动作.
我们训练VLM,以预测时间局部的相互作用来自相同的输入,没有用户提供的相互作用描述,每帧口罩,或轨迹.

blocks.en: We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to test whether added objects participate coherently in source actions while preserving the surrounding content. The general video object insertion benchmark further assesses broader editing quality. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall scores over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. Predicted temporal prompt guidance further improves interaction performance. Ablations examine contributions from data composition and interaction guidance.
blocks.zh: 我们采用 " ALIVE " 互动基准,以检验新增对象是否一致参与源行动,同时保留周围的内容。 一般的视频对象插入基准进一步评估了更广泛的编辑质量. 没有VLM指导,生存改善 在两个基准上,总体得分分别比最强评价基线高43.9%和4.4%。 预测的时间即时指导会进一步提高互动性能. 拨款审查数据构成和互动指导的贡献。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A dataset of 35,800 video editing pairs combining interaction-focused and general insertion data, with complementary visual sources and multi-level prompt annotations. • A diffusion editing framework that uses a VLM to predict interaction descriptions from the original inputs and aligns their guidance with the corresponding video intervals. • We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark and show that ALIVE outperforms baselines on interaction and general insertion, supported by ablations on data and guidance.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: • 一个35 800个视频编辑对的数据集,将互动重点数据和一般插入数据结合起来,并配有互补的视觉来源和多层次的即时说明。 二. 支助 一个传播编辑框架,使用VLM从原始投入中预测交互描述,并用相应的视频间隔来调整其指导. ^ 我们采用 " 生命互动 " 基准,并表明 " 生命互动 " 超越了互动和一般插入方面的基线,并辅之以 " 数据和指导 " 。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video editing and paired video. EditVerse, UNIC, and VACE unify diverse video editing tasks through shared conditioning interfaces ( Ju et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Goku-Edit and OpenVE-Edit support instruction-guided editing ( Liang et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ) , while Kiwi-Edit unifies instruction and reference guidance ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . First-frame-guided methods propagate initial visual edits through source videos. AnyV2V and I2VEdit build on pretrained image-to-video models ( Ku et al., 2024 ; Ouyang et al., 2024 ) , while LoRA-Edit uses mask-aware adaptation ( Gao et al., 2026a ) . Señorita, GenProp, and PropFly learn editing or propagation from paired or synthetic supervision ( Zi et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Seo et al., 2026 ) . PISCO and NovaEdit support sparse-keyframe-guided video editing ( Gao et al., 2026b ; Pan et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 视频编辑与配对视频. 编辑Verse、UNIC和VACE通过共享调节接口统一各种视频编辑任务(Ju等,2026;Ye等,2025;Jiang等,2025)。 Goku-Edit和OpenVE-Edit支持指导-指导编辑(Liang等,2026;He等,2025;Kiwi-Edit统一指导与参考指导(Lin等,2026. 第一帧制导方法通过源视频传播初始视觉编辑. AnyV2V和I2Vedit基于预先训练的图像到视频模型(Ku等,2024;Oyang等,2024;而LoRA-Edit则使用口罩-意识适应(Gao等,2026a.). Señorita, GenProp,和PropFly从对等或合成监督中学习编辑或传播(Zi等,2025;Liu等,2025b;Seo等,2026.). PISCO和NovaEdit支持稀疏的键框引导视频编辑(Gao等,2026b;Pan等,2026).

blocks.en: Paired datasets support these advances across tasks. Señorita-2M, Goku, and OpenVE cover broad editing tasks, while EffectErase and ROSE provide object removal / insertion pairs ( Zi et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Miao et al., 2025 ) . ALIVE focuses on first-frame-guided object insertion with coherent responses to source actions, supported by interaction-focused editing pairs and multi-level prompt annotations for studying interaction guidance.
blocks.zh: Paired数据集支持这些跨任务的进展. Señorita-2M,Goku,和OpenVE 承担了广泛的编辑任务,而EffectErase和ROSE提供对象去除/插入对(Zi等,2025;Liang等,2026;He等,2025;Fu等,2026;Miao等,2025). ALIVE专注于第一帧指向对象的插入,对源动作有一致的响应,辅以注重交互的编辑配对和研究交互指向的多级即时说明.

blocks.en: Interactive video editing. Interactive editing spans user control in streaming workflows and physical interactions within scenes. EditStream, JoyAI-Video-Edit, StreamEdit, and Vidu S2-Editing support streaming editing ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Jiao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . EgoPlay times edits via user-specified source events ( Mai et al., 2026 ) . EgoEdit supports instruction-guided egocentric editing and real-time streaming ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Within scenes, VOID revises downstream physical interactions after object removal ( Motamed et al., 2026 ) , while DynaEdit edits actions and dynamics through text ( Kulikov et al., 2026 ) . We study first-frame-guided object insertion, where added objects respond to source actions without user-provided interaction descriptions.
blocks.zh: 互动视频编辑. 互动编辑跨越了流出工作流程中的用户控制以及场景内的物理互动. EditStream, JoyAI-Video-Edit, StreamEdit,和Vidu S2-Editing 支持流媒体编辑(周等,2026;萧等,2026;焦等,2026;张等,2026). EgoPlay时间通过用户指定的源事件编辑(Mai等,2026.). EgoEdit支持以指导为自负心的编辑和实时流线(Li等,2026. 在场景内,VOID在物体去除后修改下游物理相互作用(Motamed等,2026年),而DynaEdit则通过文本编辑动作和动态(Kulikov等,2026年). 我们研究第一帧引导对象插入,其中被添加对象在未提供用户交互描述的情况下响应源动作.

blocks.en: VLM guidance for video editing. UniVideo and Omni-Video 2 integrate multimodal understanding with video generation and editing ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . DynVFX uses a VLM to describe a scene augmented with dynamic content ( Yatim et al., 2025 ) ; Aurora plans edits and obtains missing conditions through tools ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . VOID identifies regions affected by object removal to guide counterfactual generation ( Motamed et al., 2026 ) . ALIVE trains a VLM to infer the inserted object’s possible responses from the source video, edited first frame, and object-only instruction, expressing them as temporally localized prompts guiding corresponding video intervals.
blocks.zh: VLM 视频编辑指南. UniVideo和Omni-Video 2将多模式理解与视频生成和编辑相结合(Wei等,2026;Yang等,2026.). DynVFX使用VLM来描述一个带有动态内容的场景(Yatim等,2025年;Aurora计划通过工具来编辑并获得缺失的条件(Yu等,2026年). VOID确定受取出物体影响的区域,以指导反事实生成(Motamed等,2026年). ALIVE训练一个VLM来推断插入对象可能从源视频,编辑后的第一个帧,以及仅针对对象的指令中做出的反应,将其表达为时间定位的提示来引导相应的视频间隔.

blocks.en: 3 ALIVE Dataset and Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 生存数据集和基准

blocks.en:
Interaction-focused editing pairs are scarce, and evaluating object insertion requires assessing responses to source actions beyond appearance.
We introduce ALIVE, comprising editing pairs from four complementary sources, multi-level prompt annotations for studying interaction guidance, and the ALIVE-interaction benchmark for evaluating interaction quality and source preservation.
blocks.zh:
以互动为重点的编辑配对很少,评价对象插入需要评估对外观以外的源行动的反应.
我们采用ALIVE,包括四个互补来源的编辑对子,研究互动指导的多层次即时说明,以及评估互动质量和源保存的ALIVE互动基准。

blocks.en: 3.1 Interaction Pair Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 互动对等构建

blocks.en: Constructing these pairs requires finding suitable interaction videos and varying the target object’s presence while preserving the surrounding scene and action. We combine 3D-rendered videos , Model-generated videos , and Real-world videos for interaction examples across visual domains, supplemented by General editing pairs (ROSE) for insertion without object interaction. Each pair comprises an object-absent source video X X and an object-present target video Y Y ; its first frame provides the edited first frame E 0 E_{0} . Figure 2 summarizes construction.
blocks.zh: 构建这些对子需要找到合适的交互视频并改变目标对象的存在,同时保留周围的场景和行动. 我们把三维视频、模型生成的视频和现实世界视频结合起来,用于跨视觉域的互动实例,并辅之以通用编辑对(ROSE),用于插入而不进行对象互动。 每对都包含一个出自对象的源视频X和一个出自对象的目标视频YY;它的第一帧提供了被编辑的第一个帧E 0 E_{0}. 图2汇总了施工情况。

blocks.en: 3D-rendered videos. To obtain precisely aligned editing pairs, we use 3D assets from SpaceTimePilot ( Huang et al., 2025b ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . We manually select segments featuring object interactions and render each scene from multiple first- and third-person viewpoints. For each viewpoint, we render sequences with and without the target object while keeping the surrounding scene, camera trajectory, and animation aligned. These renders directly provide Y Y , X X , and object masks.
blocks.zh: 3D-后卫视频. 为了获得精确对齐的编辑配对,我们使用来自SpaceTimePilot的3D资产(Huang等,2025b;Lu等,2025.). 我们手动选择以对象交互为特征的片段,并从多个第一人称和第三人称角度来渲染每个场景. 对于每个角度,我们用和不使用目标对象来渲染序列,同时保持周围场景,相机轨迹和动画的对齐. 这可以直接提供Y、X和物体口罩。

blocks.en: Model-generated videos. To broaden interaction and scene coverage beyond available assets, we use GPT to design prompts covering common interaction types and synthesize object-present videos with Wan2.2 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) segments and tracks the target object, and UnderEraser ( Liu et al., 2026 ) removes it to construct the paired source video.
blocks.zh: 模型生成的视频. 为了将互动和场景覆盖范围扩大到现有资产之外,我们利用GPT设计了涵盖共同互动类型的提示并用Wan2.2合成了物体呈现的视频(Wan等,2025年)。 SAM3(Carion等,2026年)分出并跟踪目标对象,而UnderEraser(Liu等,2026年)取出以构建配对源视频.

blocks.en: Real-world videos. For real-world visual supervision, we curate interaction clips from ARCTIC ( Fan et al., 2023 ) , HOCap ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , HOI4D ( Liu et al., 2022 ) , and HOT3D ( Banerjee et al., 2025 ) . Target masks come from provided segmentations or projected object geometry, with refinement as needed. UnderEraser removes the target while retaining the surrounding action.
blocks.zh: 真实世界视频. 对于现实世界的视觉监督,我们整理来自ARCTIC(Fan等,2023年),HOCP(Wang等,2025年),HOI4D(Liu等,2022年)和HOT3D(Banerjee等,2025年)的交互片段. 目标口罩来自所提供的分块或所投射的物体几何图案,根据需要加以完善. Eraser下面删除目标,同时保留周围的动作.

blocks.en: General editing pairs (ROSE). Objects should respond to interactions but also behave appropriately in their absence, for example by remaining stationary in the scene. We include general editing pairs from ROSE ( Miao et al., 2025 ) to support this behavior, alongside effects such as shadows and reflections. We reverse its removal pairs: the object-absent result becomes X X , and the original object-present video becomes Y Y .
blocks.zh: 一般编辑对 (ROSE). 物体应对相互作用作出反应,但在没有相互作用时也要适当行事,例如在现场保持静止。 我们包括ROSE(Miao等人,2025年)的一般编辑配对,以支持这种行为,以及影子和反射等效果. 我们逆转其去除对:对象偏差结果变为X X,原始对象偏差视频变为Y Y.

blocks.en: Pair quality. We use Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and GPT-5.6 Luna/Sol for source-specific quality checks, excluding interaction videos with no visible object interaction or poor visual quality, and pairs with incomplete or visibly incorrect object removal.
blocks.zh: 配对质量. 我们使用Qwen3.6-27B(Quen Team,2026)和GPT-5.6 Luna/Sol进行源特有质量检查,不包括没有可见对象交互或视觉质量差的互动视频,以及不完全或明显不正确的对象去除的对等.

blocks.en: Our 35,800 unique pairs comprise 14,362 3D-rendered, 5,896 model-generated, 8,542 real-world, and 7,000 ROSE general editing pairs. They provide precisely aligned pairs, common interactions, real-world examples, and cases without object interaction. Section 5.3.1 evaluates different sources.
blocks.zh: 我们的35,800个独特对包括14,362个3D型,5,896个模型生成,8,542个现实世界,以及7,000个ROSE一般编辑对. 它们提供了精确的对接,共同的相互作用,现实世界的例子,以及没有对象相互作用的案例. 第5.3.1节评价了不同来源。

blocks.en: 3.2 Multi-Level Interaction Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.2 多层次互动说明

blocks.en: We investigate whether prompts improve object interactions in video editing and which descriptions are most effective. We annotate P1–P4 with varying semantic detail and temporal structure, alongside P0 (no text). P1 names only the added object. Neither P0 nor P1 describes interactions, leaving the editor to infer plausible responses from the source video and E 0 E_{0} . P2 describes the principal interaction; P3 details its sequence and outcome; P4 describes temporal chunks. P2–P4 provide interaction information to the editor. P4 can span the full clip when no phase decomposition is needed. Figure 2 illustrates these differences. These annotations enable VLM-predicted interaction prompts from the source video, E 0 E_{0} , and P1, without user-specified interaction descriptions (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们调查提示是否改善了视频编辑中的对象交互,以及哪些描述最为有效. 我们用不同的语义细节和时间结构来标注P1-P4,与P0(无正文)并列. P1 名称只包含添加的对象 。 P0和P1都没有描述互动,任由编辑推断出来源视频和E0 E_{0}的可信回应. P2描述主要相互作用;P3详细说明其序列和结果;P4描述时间块. P2–P4为编辑提供交互信息. 当不需要相位分解时,P4可以横跨整个相位. 图2说明了这些差异。 这些说明允许从源视频E0 E_{0}和P1中预示的VLM交互提示,没有用户指定的交互描述(第4.3节).

blocks.en: Qwen3.6-27B assists annotation using ordered target-video frames, target masks, and available object or action metadata, followed by selective GPT verification and refinement against the videos. Inconsistent descriptions are corrected or excluded at the affected level. For ROSE cases without object manipulation, prompts describe scene motion, occlusion, and visible object-related effects.

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价基准

blocks.en: ALIVE-interaction benchmark. We construct insertion tasks to assess coherent object responses to source actions. Each case provides an object-absent source video, an edited first frame, an object-present reference video, and P1–P4 annotations for prompt-level comparisons (Table 3 ), with P0 using no text. Its 128 cases include held-out samples from the 3D-rendered (10), model-generated (42), and real-world sources (19: ARCTIC 7, HOCap 1, HOI4D 5, and HOT3D 6), plus two out-of-domain subsets: 31 HOIGen-1M ( Liu et al., 2025a ) cases and 26 videos we recorded (RealShot). General video object insertion benchmark. Alongside interaction-focused editing, we evaluate general insertion on 103 cases: 60 from ROSE and 43 from EffectErase. A common protocol evaluates editing fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence on both benchmarks (Section 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: 活互动基准。 我们构建插入任务,以评估对源行动的一致对象反应。 每个案例都提供一个对象缺失的源视频,一个被编辑的第一帧,一个对象显示的参考视频,以及P1-P4说明,用于即时级别比较(表3),而P0则不使用文本. 其128个病例包括来自3D-交付的样本(10)、模型生成的(42)和现实世界来源(19:ARCTIC 7、HOCAP 1、HOI4D 5和HOT3D 6),外加两个域外子集:31个HOIGen-1M (Liu等人,2025a.)我们录制了26个案例和视频(RealShot. 普通视频对象插入基准. 除了注重互动的编辑之外,我们评价103个案例的一般插入情况:60个来自ROSE,43个来自EffectErase。 共同协议评价编辑忠诚、源头保存以及两个基准的视觉一致性(第5.1节)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with Existing Video Editors
blocks.zh: 5.2 与现有视频编辑器的比较

blocks.en: ALIVE substantially improves interaction-focused insertion while retaining strong general insertion quality (Table 1 ). With object-identity text alone, it exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline by 26.46 points on the ALIVE-interaction benchmark (86.71 vs. 60.24) and by 3.89 points on general insertion (92.28 vs. 88.39). Its motion/propagation score on the interaction benchmark rises to 86.13, compared with 36.52 for Señorita, supporting more coherent coordination between inserted objects and source actions. VLM-predicted P4 further raises the interaction Overall score to 87.66. For general insertion, P1 remains stronger than predicted P4 (92.28 vs. 91.71), although both outperform the evaluated baselines. Predicted interaction guidance therefore builds on an already capable editor. Section 5.3.2 examines this contribution in detail.
blocks.zh: 活下来大幅度地改进了注重互动的插入,同时保持了强有力的一般插入质量(表1)。 仅凭物体识别文本,它就超过ALIVE-Interactive基准(86.71对60.24)上最强评价基线26.46分,超过一般插入(92.28对88.39)上最强评价基线3.89分. 它在互动基准上的运动/传播得分上升至86.13分,而塞诺里塔为36.52分,支持被插入对象与源行动之间更协调一致的协调. VLM预测的P4进一步将互动总分提高到87.66分. 就一般插入而言,P1仍然比预测的P4(92.28对91.71)强,尽管两者都超过了所评估的基线。 因此,预定的互动指导以已经有能力的编辑为基础。 第5.3.2节详细审查了这一贡献。

blocks.en: We examine how each data source contributes to interaction-focused and general object insertion, and whether combining them benefits both. blocks.en: Limitations and future work. Despite these improvements, ALIVE faces limitations. The source video and edited first frame do not fully specify geometry, contact conditions, or forces, leaving multiple plausible object responses. For example, a soft object may deform differently under pressure depending on stiffness, while a partially occluded grasp may allow a cup to remain upright or tilt during lifting. ALIVE aims to generate plausible object responses consistent with source actions, without implausible deformation, interpenetration, or unsupported floating. Additionally, VLM-predicted guidance errors can cause incorrect behavior, and the editor still struggles with complex cloth deformations and rapid, large-angle rotations. Future work includes improving guidance reliability, strengthening the editor’s ability to generate complex interactions, and incorporating explicit physical information for greater accuracy and control. Combining ALIVE with Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025a ) or EditStream ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) could enable real-time streaming object insertion.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented ALIVE, a framework for inserting objects that participate coherently in a source video’s interactions. Our dataset combines complementary construction routes, and our benchmarks assess both interaction-focused and general object insertion. Experiments show the benefit of interaction-focused editor training and clarify the effects of data composition and prompt guidance. VLM-predicted guidance further improves interaction editing without additional user input, with P4 performing best among the evaluated prediction formats.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了“生命”这个框架,用于插入一致参与源视频互动的物体。 我们的数据集结合了互补的构造路线,我们的基准评估了互动重点和一般物体的插入。 实验显示了注重互动的编辑培训的好处并澄清了数据构成和即时指导的效果. VLM所预想的指南进一步改善了互动编辑而无需额外的用户输入,P4在被评价的预测格式中表现最好.

blocks.en: Frame sampling and alignment. We align source and reference evidence to each generator’s input preprocessing so that evaluation reflects the field of view and time span available during generation. We uniformly sample 16 native output frames, including both endpoints, and map them to the source frames selected by the generator. For I2VEdit, we use all 14 native frames without repetition or interpolation. Spatial alignment follows the generator’s documented aspect-preserving cover resize and fixed center crop, including interpolation and rounding conventions.
blocks.zh: 框架取样和对齐。 我们把来源和参考证据与每个生成器的输入预处理统一起来,使评价能够反映生成过程中的视野和时间跨度。 我们统一抽取16个本土输出帧,包括两个端点,并将其映射到生成器选择的源帧. 对I2Vedit来说,我们使用所有14个本土帧,没有重复或插入. 空间对接遵循了生成器记录的外观保护覆盖物的大小调整和固定中心作物,包括插图和圆圈等。

blocks.en: At each timepoint, SOURCE, REFERENCE, and CANDIDATE appear side by side with their aspect ratios preserved. Four contact sheets show 5, 5, 5, and 1 timepoints; I2VEdit uses three sheets with 5, 5, and 4. The aligned E 0 E_{0} is supplied separately as a PNG. Each labeled cell measures × 240 384\!\times\!240 pixels, and sheets use JPEG quality 88. Time labels indicate normalized positions rather than seconds. Layout margins, labels, and gaps are excluded from scoring; artifacts within video regions remain scoreable.

blocks.en: Scoring and aggregation. Table 8 defines six dimensions and their weights. For candidate i i and dimension d d , the judge assigns an integer s i , d ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } s_{i,d}\in\{0,1,2,3,4\} : 0 denotes failure or contradictory evidence, 2 partial correctness with a material problem, and 4 full satisfaction supported by visible evidence. Scores 1 and 3 fall between these anchors. We assess plausible interactions consistent with SOURCE and E 0 E_{0} , allowing reasonable spatial and temporal differences from the reference (Figure 6 ). Missing required interactions, broken contact, impossible motion, and source corruption remain errors.

blocks.en: Structured response. The request also supplies a JSON schema requiring five fields: scores , justifications , failure_flags , judge_confidence , and summary . Both scores and justifications contain all six dimension keys in Figure 6 ; values are integers in [ 0 , 4 ] [0,4] and nonempty strings, respectively. Confidence is a number in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and the summary is a nonempty string. Additional keys are disallowed in the root object and both dimension objects. Failure flags form a possibly empty array drawn from missing_target , wrong_target , motion_not_followed , incomplete_propagation , wrong_motion_or_placement , source_corruption , temporal_breakdown , first_frame_mismatch , and catastrophic_artifacts .
